closed_or_reduced_gaps: Pantheon+ STAT+SYS full covariance was materialized from the pinned official source and executed, replacing the historical missing-covariance state for this workflow.
CPL was added as a mandatory third-model control under the same Pantheon+ full-covariance likelihood as LCDM and RLL.
DES-Dovekie HD and STAT+SYS precision inputs were materialized from immutable upstream Git objects and verified as 1820 ordered supernova rows plus an 1820x1820 positive-definite precision matrix.
DES-Dovekie LCDM/CPL/RLL full-precision fits were executed under one profiled magnitude-offset policy without claiming an H0 measurement.
First-run Dovekie SHA-256 and byte counts were obtained and subsequently pinned in the experiment contract.

des_dovekie.nuisance_policy: one additive SN magnitude offset analytically profiled; H0 fixed only as a reference distance scale and not inferred

interpretation.scientific_summary: On both materialized SN likelihoods, RLL collapses to an LCDM-like likelihood while carrying extra parameters. The Dovekie CPL maximum-likelihood improvement is real at the declared numerical fit level but its wa optimum lies on the lower bound, so parameter interpretation requires a bound/profile sensitivity analysis.

diagnostic_provenance.identifiability_assessment: post-run audit from immutable fit runs and observed redshift support

F_ok: Pantheon+ and DES-Dovekie now have materialized full matrix SN likelihood executions in the same PR branch.
CPL is present as a control model in both likelihoods.
Negative RLL results are preserved rather than optimized away or promoted.
Dovekie precision semantics, source ordering, hashes and byte counts are explicit and auditable.
F_gap: Pantheon+SH0ES and Dovekie are not yet a clean calibration/sample ablation because their absolute-calibration/nuisance contracts differ.
Dovekie CPL wa is boundary-limited and requires a profile/bound sensitivity run.
SN-only RLL transition parameters are not identifiable when the solution hides outside observed redshift support or collapses to Omega_s0=0.
Real nested-sampling evidence, official DESI DR2 reproduction and physical perturbation/growth likelihoods remain open.
F_next: Build a Pantheon+ Hubble-flow-only profiled-offset companion likelihood to match the Dovekie nuisance contract.
Run CPL wa bound/profile sensitivity before interpreting its Dovekie best-fit parameters.
Move the next validation gate to official DESI DR2 reproduction plus real nested-sampling evidence, followed by CLASS/CAMB and DES Y6 growth.
